incident_name: Launch-level hook refactoring plan (issue 394), three adversarial plan reviews

baseline_environment.orchestrator_model: claude-sonnet-5-5 for H4.jsonl lines 880-1060 (the session later also ran 1,022 messages on model gpt-6.1-sol)

severity_rule: Blocking = wrong behaviour, a false claim, a missing required item, a security or acceptance-criterion hole (reviewer briefs name a leak to main/master as blocking). Minor = wording, format. Binary verdict: PASS only with no blocking finding. Cap: 2 fix cycles, 3 reviews, then escalate (output-style rule, inputs/owner/output-style-pragmatic-L15.md, restated in the briefs).

M1.reason: no review passed; the loop stopped at the cap of 3 reviews after 2 fix cycles, then the owner confirmed no further review (H4.jsonl L1059, L1082)
M1.basis: read: parent summaries H4.jsonl L946, L999, L1059; verdict lines of the three review files

M2.basis: read: plan-review.md:7-8; ids B-1..B-8 and M-1..M-14 re-counted by script (derived), match

M3.reviewer_origin_tag_reason: the review files carry no origin tags

M4.basis: derived: replay of the recorded Write+Edit calls (tools/replay_plan.py); line counts equal what the reviewers' own Read calls returned (tools/crosscheck_reads.py); bytes are derived, v2 bytes equal the file on disk

M5.basis: derived: tools/agent_costs.py over the subagent logs (unique API messages and tool_use ids; usage from the last record of each message id)

M2.basis: read: plan-review-2.md:7-8; ids F-1..F-8, m-1..m-12 re-counted (derived), match

M3.reviewer_origin_tag_reason: no origin tags; the review says which round-1 findings were closed (plan-review-2.md:12-25) but not which new ones the fix caused

analyst_rederivation.evidence: F-2 canonical push form, F-3 GET-only gh api form and F-4 the O-16 justification do not exist in v0 (rg counts 0) and appear in v1. F-1: the later-git-word exemption (G4) is already in v0 line 218; only the NM2 line join is new in v1 (partly). F-8: the over-block of a one-line PR title that mentions git comes from the v0 first-git-word UNKNOWN rule, but the false sentence 'one-line commit messages and PR titles that mention git are not blocked' (the mention of PR titles) first appears in v1 line 234, written by fix cycle 1 for B-8 (partly). F-5: v0 decision-table row 33 pins `$GIT push origin main` (v0 line 421). F-6 and F-7: v0 N2 already deletes every quote and backslash and v0 N4 already removes a redirection together with the next word (v0 lines 192, 194).
analyst_rederivation.method: derived: replay of the plan versions, rg over v0, v1, v2 text; reading of the rule text only, nothing was executed; the review itself gives no origin tag
analyst_rederivation.discrepancy_with_phase1: phase-1 REPORT.md (I3 table) says 7 of 8 trace to fix cycle 1 and names NM4 as added by fix cycle 1; v0 already had the same redirection step (called N4), so that count is not supported. Use share_lower to share_upper.

M2.basis: read: plan-review-3.md:7-8; ids B-1..B-10, m-1..m-11 re-counted (derived), match

analyst_rederivation.evidence: B-6: the rule 'segment split runs only when W contains git, gh, orca, superclaude or repos/' exists only in v2 (v2 line 209). B-3: v2 replaces 'first git word per segment' by command position and adds the position-free global rule, so the wrapper and keyword routes are new in shape. B-1 and B-2: v1 NM2 already joined continuation lines with a space and deleted every quote (v1 line 197), so `gi\<newline>t` and `$'git'` were already hidden in v1. B-4, B-5, B-7, B-8, B-9: tamper list, R10 (curl), npx and the `superclaude install` rule are in v0 (v0 lines 321-322). B-10: the 'No S, UNKNOWN for a first word' rule is in v0 and v1 (v0 line 210), so it probably existed in v1 too, but I did not run it.
analyst_rederivation.method: derived: replay of the plan versions, rg over v0, v1, v2 text; reading of the rule text only, nothing was executed; the review itself gives no origin tag

M4.basis: no fix cycle after review 3 (cap reached, owner stop at H4.jsonl L1082); the later merge executor output is not part of this loop

line_count_note: Phase-1 report quotes 1,054 / 1,139 / 1,314 lines: that is the last line number a Read returned, one past the final line (an empty trailing row). Actual line counts are 1,053 / 1,138 / 1,313.
token_caveat: cache_read and cache_creation tokens count the repeated context of every turn; compare output_tokens, api_messages and tool_calls between runs, not cache totals.
